name: admin-webapp
description: The store-owner back office: a React SPA where a signed-in Admin adds/edits/removes products, tracks and updates inventory levels, and reviews/updates order fulfillment status. It is a distinct surface from the shopper storefront because its user (the store operator) and its lifecycle (internal tooling, not a public shopping flow) differ. It holds no secrets and does not expose any shopper-facing catalog or cart UI.

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Ceramics API's admin operations to manage products, inventory, and order fulfillment status.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC sign-in (PKCE) so only an authenticated Admin can reach the back office.
